name: Ogniad
sources: Gwynn, Edward. The Metrical Dindshenchas. Part II. Vol. IX. Royal Irish Academy, Todd Lecture Series. Dublin: Hodges, Figgis, and Co., Ltd., 1906–1924, 9.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ogniad is an Irish heroine or goddess. She was the daughter of Midir, an important Fairy king, and the mother of the hero Sigmall. Little is known of her beyond a lawless, self-willed nature. The text does not make clear whether Midir's consort Etain was her mother.

okr.objective: Ogniad is a daughter of Midir and mother of Sigmall.
key_results: She was the mother of the hero Sigmall.
Fairy king Midir was her father.
Whether Etain was her mother is unclear.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
